text:
The Kings arrive in New York at 2-3-0 over their last five, coming off a 3-1 loss at New Jersey that was lopsided by the chances too (they had 23% of the expected goals, a measure of shot quality). They're without Mats Zuccarello and Alex Turcotte, and Joel Armia is next in line for Zuccarello's minutes. Quinton Byfield could return, now day-to-day. The Rangers are 1-3-1 in their last five, outscored 22-14, after a 7-4 loss in Ottawa in which Drake Batherson scored three. Igor Shesterkin is on injured reserve. Adam Fox plays his 500th NHL game.

Our numbers see little between them: LAK has 48% of the expected goals at five on five, NYR 51%, and the model has it 3.12 to 2.88 for New York. The Rangers' power play (0.69 expected goals a game) and penalty kill (0.52 allowed) both beat the Kings' (0.48 and 0.68), and LAK takes 4.3 penalties a game. The Rangers' projected goalie is unclear. Darcy Kuemper is the projected Kings starter, at -1.17 goals saved above expected this season (-6.77 last year), meaning he has let in more than shot quality suggests.

Artemi Panarin, facing his old team, is 70% for a point, and the Miami Herald headlined the game around him. Alexis Lafrenière is 61% for a point, and Bleacher Report's Adam Herman posted that he has been at a point-per-game pace "dating back to the Panarin trade." Adrian Kempe is our model's top Kings scorer pick at 36%. Our under-the-radar pick is Alex Laferriere, 54% for a point because his projected ice time (20:31) is above his season average, a player to watch, not a lock.
